Landing.heroTitle: The karaoke queue on the TV. The control, in everyone's hands.
Landing.heroSub: Everyone scans the QR, picks a song on their own phone, and the TV plays the queue by itself — on a fair rotation. No app, no sign-up.
Landing.createFine: Your room is ready in 30 seconds, TV and QR included.
Landing.demoAlt: Preview of the Boraoke TV screen: the song playing now, the up-next list with nicknames and tables, the rotation-mode tag, and a phone showing the join QR.
Landing.demoNext1Title: Como É Grande o Meu Amor por Você
Landing.demoPhoneBody: Nickname, table and song — straight from the browser.
Landing.feature1Body: Nickname and table, right in the phone's browser. Zero friction for your guests.
Landing.feature2Body: Search inside Boraoke or paste the link. Plays in the official player, full screen.
Landing.feature3Body: Three modes — full karaoke, 2 per table, 1 per person. Nobody hogs the mic.
Landing.freePromise: Everything that exists today is free, in early access.
Landing.haveCodeHint: Enter the room code (or paste the link you were given).
Landing.footer: Boraoke early access · pt-BR / EN / ES
Landing.savedHint: Saved on this device — jump back into a room you created or joined.

New.createIntro: Give us your bar's name. We'll generate the link, the QR, and the host code.

New.showQrHint: Show this QR at the bar or leave it on the /tv screen.
New.ephemeralNotice: ⚠️ Rooms are still temporary — they can expire when the server restarts. Use the room now and recreate it if the link stops working. Permanent rooms are on the way.
New.hostCodeHint: This is how you run the queue at /admin. It shows up only once — keep it somewhere safe.

Modes.fullKaraokeRule: Everyone joins the queue, first come first served.
Modes.perTableRule: Max 2 songs queued per table; a table comes back around once it plays.
Modes.perPersonRule: Each person keeps 1 song queued; a fair rotation by identity.

Meta.title: Boraoke — the karaoke queue on the TV, on everyone’s phone
Meta.description: Bar, party, building or office: everyone scans the QR and picks a song on their phone. The TV plays the queue by itself, on a fair rotation. No app, free.
Meta.ogDescription: Everyone scans the QR and picks a song. The TV plays the queue by itself, on a fair rotation. Free.
